entries.title: Dawn of Man
entries.definitive_edition: Dawn of Man on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the original release route, has current PC storefront support, and is the best capture/settings option. PS4 and Xbox One are valid console ports, but they do not add sourced exclusive gameplay content over PC.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC version through Steam or GOG. Use PS4 or Xbox One only if a console route is preferred.

entries.remaster_caveats: The PS4 and Xbox One versions are console ports, not remasters or separate game entries.
